subject: Re: URGENT: tool calling payload not valid JSON (prod)
body:
From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@heliopay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: oncall@heliopay.com
Date: Wed, Feb 12, 2025 at 10:18 AM
Subject: URGENT: tool calling payload not valid JSON (prod)

Hi Kimberly,

We’re seeing production failures in our tool-calling integration. The `tool_calls[0].arguments` value is sometimes not parseable JSON (trailing commas / newline escaping). Our service uses a strict JSON parser and crashes on this.

Attaching a sample payload and a screenshot from our error logs.

Can you confirm whether Redwood guarantees valid JSON here and if there is an immediate mitigation?

Thanks,
Nina

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@heliopay.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 12, 2025 at 10:44 AM
Subject: Re: URGENT: tool calling payload not valid JSON (prod)

Nina — thanks for the concrete sample. We’re treating this as an escalation. I’ve opened a ticket with engineering (SUP-1842) and we’re investigating a potential regression related to streaming.

Immediate mitigations we can try:
- Disable streaming for tool-call routes if acceptable
- Add a JSON validation step and retry once if invalid

I’ll update you within 2 hours with what we learn.

Best,
Kimberly
Customer Success
Redwood Inference

---

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@heliopay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 12, 2025 at 12:21 PM
Subject: Re: URGENT: tool calling payload not valid JSON (prod)

Hi Nina,

Engineering found an issue in our tool-call delta coalescing when streaming. We’re rolling back a config flag in us-east right now.

Could you retry in ~15 minutes and let us know if you still see malformed JSON?

Thanks,
Aisha
Support Engineering
Redwood Inference

---

From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@heliopay.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 12, 2025 at 1:02 PM
Subject: Re: URGENT: tool calling payload not valid JSON (prod)

We retried and it looks improved. We’ll monitor and share examples if it happens again.

Thank you for moving quickly.
